draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Nileshwar! It's called the cultural capital of Kasaragod, Kerala's northernmost district. The town sits on the estuary of the Kavvayi backwaters and the Nileshwaram river.
draft.hungryLine: Nileshwar eats along the highway. Try Vasantha Vihar for vegetarian, or the KTDC Restaurant, which even Wikivoyage praises.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Nileshwar Muthappan Madappura is a 3 min walk. Then head out to Kottappuram for the Valiyaparamba backwaters.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Catch the sunset at Azhithala, about 9 km away, where the Tejaswini river meets the Arabian Sea.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Nileshwar's auto drivers are a story of their own. Many have formed a small socialist group and admire rebel leader V.S. Achuthanandan with great passion.

legends.title: The mysterious lamps
legends.body: At Benkana Kavu stands a kanhiram tree known as The Sacred Tree. Its mysterious lamps are lit on Tuesdays and Fridays after 10 PM.

legends.title: Porat in Meenam
legends.body: Porat is performed at Anjoottabalam Veerarkavu, and Pooram at Cheermakkavu, in the month of Meenam. Together with Vishukkaliyattam they draw thousands of people.

tips.title: Plan around Meenam.
tips.body: Pooram, Porat and Vishukkaliyattam fill Nileshwar's temples with crowds in the month of Meenam.

tips.title: Ask where Theyyam is on.
tips.body: Theyyam is performed only in select temples and family temples, so check locally.

story.title: Kavus and temples
story.body: Nileshwar is full of kavus and temples, from the Riverside Bhagavathy Temple near the bazaar to the Taliyil Siva Temple. Theyyam is still performed in select temples and family shrines.

story.title: A famous candidate
story.body: E.M.S. Namboodiripad, the first Chief Minister of Kerala, contested Assembly elections from the Neeleshwaram seat.

story.title: A town on the water
story.body: Nileshwar is one of only three municipalities in Kasaragod district. Kottappuram, part of the municipality, has eleven houseboats for rent on the backwaters.
